title: What we had to fix between an AI sprite sheet and the character picker in NECROTIDE
author: Sindorus1
selftext:
We used image generation for some character art in our PC game. One snag was surprisingly visible: a sheet could look fine in isolation and still give every animation frame a bright rectangular background. We removed the background before slicing the frames, then checked the animations against the dark battlefield. The character picker here shows why we also review the cast together: at selection size, the silhouette has to carry more of the identity than the little costume details.



Nothing is generated while you play. I’d be interested in how other teams check a whole roster at its actual on-screen size.
